name: Orbit
tagline: Live face recognition that recalls who someone is, transcribes your talk and maps your professional network.

awards: Windsurf: Best Project built with Windsurf

problem: Networking starts with guesswork and the context is forgotten afterwards.
solution: Recognizes faces and pulls public profiles, indexes identities across sessions with conversation history, transcribes live with follow-up suggestions, and maps relationships.
demo_moment: Team-described: look at someone and see who they are and what you last discussed.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Windsurf: Best Project built with Windsurf” and “Groq” among 261 submissions.
Covers before, during and after a conversation.
Real-time face recognition of strangers raises consent issues the summary does not address.

lessons: Face-recognition demos impress, and invite privacy questions.
